title: LeetLLM Blog Post Metadata
description: Schema for canonical blog JSON frontmatter and supported legacy metadata.json bundles

visibility.description: Publication channels. Omitted channels default to visible; blog posts are not selected by the curriculum book builder.

id.description: Unique identifier for the blog post (e.g. blog-swe-bench-deep-dive)

slug.description: URL-safe slug for the blog post

aliases.description: Previous URL slugs that permanently redirect to this canonical post. Keep aliases on the replacement post when its slug changes.

avatar.description: URL or path to author avatar image

updatedAt.description: Last update date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional)

verifiedAt.description: Date volatile claims, prices, and product behavior were last verified against primary sources. Must be paired with refreshAfter.

refreshAfter.description: Date after which a published post must be reverified. Must be later than verifiedAt and paired with it.

excerpt.description: Short excerpt shown in blog listing and meta description

coverImage.description: Path or URL for the blog post cover/hero image

tags.description: Tags for categorizing the blog post

featured.description: Whether the post should be featured/pinned

draft.description: Whether the post is a draft (hidden from listing)

private.description: Whether the post is private (hidden from public listing and sitemap, but accessible via direct URL or /blog/all)

redirectTo.description: Permanent replacement URL for a retired post that remains as its own content bundle. Prefer aliases on the canonical post for ordinary slug changes.
